crossrefs.text: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
God did not reject His people, whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah, how he appealed to God against Israel:
Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
He delivers and rescues; He performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth, for He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions.”
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
In the future, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ you are to tell him, ‘With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
“Your servants have come from a very distant land,” they replied, “because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard the reports about Him: all that He did in Egypt,
Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
And the angel of God, who had gone before the camp of Israel, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them,
He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses. Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them,
who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season. But as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the waterʼs edge,

the flowing water stood still. It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan, while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
